wc:minerva-input.summary: Text field with prefix / suffix, clear button and character count.
wc:minerva-input.description: Single-line text field (`<Input>` of React) with prefix / suffix slots, clear button, character count and password visibility toggle. Form-associated: submits `value` under `name`, supports `required`, `minlength` / `maxlength` / `pattern` / `min` / `max` validation (the browser's messages, from the inner `<input>`), `form.reset()` and `<fieldset disabled>`. Name it with `<label for>`, a wrapping `<label>`, `aria-label` or `aria-labelledby`.

properties.description: Regular expression the value must match

properties.description: Accessible label of the clear button (default: localized "Clear")

properties.description: Shows the number of characters (and maxlength) after the text

properties.description: Label of the password toggle while hidden (default: localized)

properties.description: Label of the password toggle while visible (default: localized)

properties.name: name
properties.description: Name submitted with the form data

properties.name: disabled
properties.description: Disables the control (not focusable, not submitted, not validated)

properties.description: The control must have a value for the form to be submitted

translationResources.title: Input

basic.title: Basic usage
basic.description: Native input attributes and events pass through; className styles the wrapper and ref reaches the <input>.

sizes-variants.title: Sizes and variants
sizes-variants.description: Three sizes and the outline, filled and unstyled variants.

addons.title: Prefix and suffix
addons.description: Decorative content such as icons, symbols or units.

clearable-and-count.title: Clear button and character count
clearable-and-count.description: clearable shows a labelled clear button while the field has a value; clearing fires onChange with an empty value and keeps focus in the field. showCharCount shows the length (and maxLength) and links it to the input.

password.title: Password
password.description: type="password" adds a show / hide toggle button with a localized label.

states.title: States
states.description: invalid, disabled and readOnly; inside a FormField the state is inherited. Read-only fields use --readonly-surface-color, keep normal text contrast and remain focusable for selecting and copying. They do not show editing affordances; invalid borders remain visible.

validation.title: Validation
validation.description: Validate on submit and show the message with the FormField errorMessage: the input becomes invalid and is described by the message.

InputProps.invalid: Error state (also set by an invalid FormControl); sets aria-invalid
InputProps.prefix: Content before the text, e.g. an icon or "@"
InputProps.suffix: Content after the text, e.g. a unit, an icon or a button
InputProps.className: Class name of the outer wrapper (not the <input>)
InputProps.clearable: Shows a clear button while the field has a value (not when disabled or read-only); clearing fires onChange with an empty value
InputProps.onClear: Called after the clear button emptied the field
InputProps.clearLabel: Accessible label of the clear button (defaults to a localized "Clear")
InputProps.showCharCount: Shows the number of characters (and maxLength, when set), linked to the input with aria-describedby
InputProps.showPasswordLabel: Accessible label of the password toggle while the password is hidden
InputProps.hidePasswordLabel: Accessible label of the password toggle while the password is visible

cssVars.--input-height: Minimum height of the field (every size; defaults to the density's control height of the size)
cssVars.--input-padding-x: Horizontal padding of the text (every size)
cssVars.--input-background: Background color of the outline variant

props.defaultValue: Initial value (the value attribute), restored by form.reset(). Like <input>, changing it also changes value until the user edits the field.
props.type: Type of the inner <input> (text, email, password, search, url, number, date…).
props.placeholder: Placeholder text shown while the field is empty.
props.readOnly: Read-only: focusable and submitted, but not editable.
props.minLength: Minimum length of the value (validated by the browser).
props.maxLength: Maximum length of the value; also the limit of the character count.
props.pattern: Regular expression the value must match.
props.name: Name under which the value is submitted with the form.
props.disabled: Disables the control: not focusable, not submitted, not validated.
props.required: The control must have a value for the form to be submitted.
props.value: Current value (property; the value attribute sets defaultValue).
props.isDisabled: Whether the control is disabled, by itself or by a disabled <fieldset> (read-only).
props.labels: The <label> elements associated with the element (read-only).
props.validationMessage: Message of the current validation error; empty when valid (read-only).
props.willValidate: Whether the element takes part in constraint validation (read-only).

events.change: The value was committed (blur or Enter), re-dispatched from the inner input.
events.input: The value changed (each keystroke; native, composed).
events.minerva-input: Same as input, with detail: { value }.
events.minerva-change: Same as change, with detail: { value }.
events.minerva-clear: The clear button emptied the field.

slots.suffix: Content after the text (unit, icon, button).

methods.blur: Removes focus from the inner control.
methods.checkValidity: Checks validity; fires invalid when the element is invalid.
methods.reportValidity: Checks validity and shows the browser's validation message.
methods.setCustomValidity: Sets a custom validation error, or clears it with an empty string.
methods.formResetCallback: Form lifecycle callback called by form.reset(): restores the initial value.
methods.formDisabledCallback: Form lifecycle callback called when an ancestor <fieldset> is disabled or enabled.
methods.formStateRestoreCallback: Form lifecycle callback called when the browser restores the state (history navigation, autofill).
